nodes.description: Private mapping of token balances per address; written by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Private nested mapping of allowances owner=>spender=>amount; written by _approve.
Private total token supply; increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Token name string set once in the ERC20 constructor.
Token symbol string set once in the ERC20 constructor.
Token decimals, default 18, changeable via _setupDecimals.
Declared owner address; never assigned or used in this contract.
Constant expected total supply of 8888888888 * 10**18 verified in the SkyX constructor.
Constructor taking holder and balance arrays, loops calling _mint and checks total supply equals TOTAL_SUPPLY.
Internal mint that increases _totalSupply and credits _balances[account] after the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
Internal transfer moving amount between balances with SafeMath sub/add and emitting Transfer.
External transfer from _msgSender() to recipient.
External transferFrom that moves tokens and decreases the caller allowance.
External approve setting allowance from _msgSender() to spender.
Atomically increases the caller allowance using SafeMath add.
Atomically decreases the caller allowance using SafeMath sub.
Internal allowance writer validating non-zero owner and spender.
Internal burn reducing _balances[account] and _totalSupply.
Returns msg.sender as address payable; the single origin of caller identity.
Empty hook called before every transfer, mint and burn.
Read-only balance lookup in _balances.
Read-only total supply getter used by the SkyX constructor require.
Read-only allowance lookup in _allowances.
Sends ETH to a payable recipient using a low-level call.value, warning about reentrancy.
Private helper performing a low-level target.call.value(weiValue)(data) after isContract check.
Internal setter for _decimals, intended to be constructor-only.
Safe subtraction reverting on underflow; used for balance and allowance decreases.
Safe addition reverting on overflow; used for balance and supply increases.
Safe multiplication reverting on overflow.
Safe division reverting on division by zero.
Caller-controlled address returned by _msgSender and used as the acting account.
Low-level external call target.call.value(weiValue)(data) in _functionCallWithValue, forwards value and control to an arbitrary contract.
Low-level external call recipient.call.value(amount)("") in Address.sendValue, transfers control and ETH to the recipient.
Array of recipient addresses passed to the SkyX constructor.
Array of mint amounts passed to the SkyX constructor, length-checked against holders.
Loop counter over holders in the SkyX constructor.
Mint/burn target account parameter.
Amount parameter for mint/burn/transfer operations.
Source address parameter of _transfer and transferFrom.
Destination address parameter of _transfer and transfer.
Allowance owner parameter of _approve.
Allowance spender parameter of _approve, approve and increase/decreaseAllowance.
Allowance increment passed to increaseAllowance.
Allowance decrement passed to decreaseAllowance.
Temporary result variable inside SafeMath.add/sub/mul/div.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned verbatim by _msgSender, propagating caller-controlled identity.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the acting account.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender for allowance bookkeeping.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
increaseAllowance reads _msgSender() allowance.
decreaseAllowance reads _msgSender() allowance.
transfer delegates the state change to _transfer.
transferFrom first performs _transfer.
transferFrom then decreases the caller allowance via _approve.
approve delegates allowance writing to _approve.
increaseAllowance writes the increased allowance via _approve.
decreaseAllowance writes the decreased allowance via _approve.
_transfer debits and credits entries of the _balances mapping.
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
_mint increases _totalSupply by amount.
_mint credits _balances[account].
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before minting.
_burn debits _balances[account].
_burn reduces _totalSupply.
_approve writes the _allowances nested mapping.
SkyX constructor loops and calls _mint for each holder.
Constructor require compares minted supply against the TOTAL_SUPPLY constant.
Constructor final check calls totalSupply().
_transfer subtracts the amount from the sender balance using SafeMath.sub to prevent underflow.
_transfer adds the amount to the recipient balance using SafeMath.add to prevent overflow.
_mint uses SafeMath.add for total supply and balance increases.
_burn uses SafeMath.sub for balance and supply decreases.
_functionCallWithValue performs target.call.value(weiValue)(data), handing control and ETH to untrusted external code before returning.
sendValue performs recipient.call.value(amount)(""), transferring control to the recipient who may re-enter.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
allowance reads the _allowances mapping.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply.
holders array parameter drives the constructor mint loop.
balances array parameter supplies the mint amounts, length-checked against holders.
Loop counter i controls iteration of the constructor mint loop.
Index i selects the holder and balance entries forwarded to _mint.
account parameter is the mint/burn target in _mint and _burn.
amount parameter is the value added to supply and balances in _mint.
sender parameter selects the debited balance entry in _transfer.
recipient parameter selects the credited balance entry in _transfer.
owner parameter indexes the first level of _allowances in _approve.
spender parameter indexes the second level of _allowances in _approve.
addedValue flows into the SafeMath.add allowance increase in increaseAllowance.
subtractedValue flows into the SafeMath.sub allowance decrease in decreaseAllowance.
Local variable c holds the SafeMath arithmetic result before being returned.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor-only array argument that directly drives the _mint loop in the constructor.
Constructor-only array argument supplying mint amounts, coupled to holders length.
Ephemeral loop index whose only purpose is iterating the constructor mint loop.
Mint/burn target parameter; its semantics are fully captured by the _mint operation.
Amount parameter consumed directly by the _mint supply and balance updates.
Source address parameter used only to index _balances inside _transfer.
Destination address parameter used only to index _balances inside _transfer.
Allowance owner parameter whose only role is indexing _allowances in _approve.
Allowance spender parameter whose only role is indexing _allowances in _approve.
Scalar increment that is immediately added to the allowance by increaseAllowance.
Scalar decrement that is immediately subtracted from the allowance by decreaseAllowance.
Temporary arithmetic result local inside the SafeMath helpers, fully internal to the arithmetic operation.
